text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-M-02 4" Stainless Steel Square Cabinet Pull

This contemporary Heidegger square cabinet pull is the perfect accent for any home. Constructed out of stainless steel, the unexpected modern shape is an excellent way to add elegance to any cabinet door; and since it is made by Acorn, you can be sure that it will last for many years to come. It comes in a soft brushed stainless steel finish and has a 4" center to center (distance between the 2 mounting holes).

Also available: Matching Stainless Steel Square Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Heidegger Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Diameter: 5/8" Square
  • Package includes 1 square pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
